detail_text: Specifically, the firm's current sterility testing methods for prepared sterile drug products are not being completed in accordance to their written procedure SOP 11.050.2 in that their sample size does not match what is required by the procedure and is not sufficient to be representative ofthe batch ofsterile product produced. In addition, their formula worksheets contain spaces for sample documentation, but do not specify how much sample should be tested by the sterile processing employee. There is also no documentation for how much sample was actually selected for testing. For example: 1) The Formula Worksheet for EDT A/Mag Sulfate PF 3 gm/lgm/20ml injectable involves the production of redacted [redacted] x 100 ml vials ofthe preservative free sterile product. Although not specified on the sampling section ofthe form, 3 x I ml each was tested by the firm for sterility assurance. The sample size according to their procedure should have been redacted [redacted] mls from each of redacted [redacted] x 100 ml vials. 2) The Formula Worksheet for Pbosphatidyl Choline I.V. Pres 5% Inj includes the production of redacted [redacted] x 30 ml vials of the sterile injectable product. Although not specified on the sampling section ofthe form, I x 30 ml vials was sent for testing to a contract lab. The sample size according to the written procedure should have been a minimum of red acted [redacted] ml from each redacted [redacted] vial. 3) The Formula Worksheet for Methylcobalamin PF 25 MGIML lnj includes the production of redacted [redacted] x 30 ml vials of preservative free sterile product. Although not specified on the sampling section of the form, I x 30 mi vials was tested by the firm for sterility assurance. The sample size according to their written procedure should have been a minimum of redacted [redacted] ml from each of redacted [redacted] separate vials. Finally, the firm has failed to perform growth testing for any ofthe media which they purchase for conducting in house sterility testing. In addition, the Endosafe-PTS used by the firm to test produced sterile drug products for endotoxin has not been calibrated to assure the quality ofthe data produced by the equipment. '· 무균 의약품을 생산하는 인원은 멸균 착의 물품으로 무균복을 착용하지 않는다. 귀사 직원은 무균 의약품을 생산하는 구역에서 비멸균 가운, 신발 덮개, 마스크, 헤어넷, 장갑을 사용한다. c. 귀사 인원은 무균 의약품을 생산하는 ISO 5 클린룸에서 눈, 목, 머리 주변의 피부가 노출되어 있다. 이들은 보안경이나 멸균 고글을 착용하지 않는다. d. 26 AUG 2014, 기술원 REDACTION [redacted] 이 비관리 약국 구역에서 신발 덮개와 가운을 착용한 채 ISO 7 룸에 들어가는 것이 관찰되었다. 그녀는 같은 신발 덮개와 가운을 추가 보호 장비 없이 ISO 5 클린룸까지 착용하고 들어가 Testosterone Cypionate, Lot 140826A, 200mg/mL 를 생산했다. e. 29 AUG 2014, 기술원 RE DACTION [redacted] 은 새로운 문서화되지 않은 착의 절차가 있다고 진술했다. 그녀는 ISO 7 구역에서 신발 덮개, 가운, 마스크, 헤어넷, 장갑을 착용했다. ISO 6 구역에서는 평상복 상태로 탈의한 뒤 ISO 5 클린룸에 들어가기 전에 새 비멸균 신발 덮개, 가운, 마스크, 헤어넷, 장갑을 착용했다. f. 26 AUG 2014, 직원 RE DACTION [redacted] 은 화장을 한 채 ISO 5 구역에서 Testosterone Cypionate, lot 140826A, 200 mg/mL 의 무균 조제를 수행했다. 또한 그녀의 마스크는 코를 덮지 않았고 앞머리는 헤어넷 안에 들어가 있지 않았다.
